abstract: Issues statutory public safety authorizations and excavation clearance certificates
system_message:
You are the Municipal pipeline safety liaison (REG), responsible for issuing statutory public safety authorizations, excavation clearance certificates, and overseeing public stakeholder notifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public stakeholder notification（PUB）
information_points.content:
REG-PUB-BAT：Under the Continuous guided-wave screening protocol, public stakeholder notification filings specify a notice delivery radius of 500 m.
REG-PUB-01Y：Under the Pulsed eddy-current mapping protocol, public stakeholder notification filings specify a notice delivery radius of 1000 m.
REG-PUB-RI0：Under the Phased-array ultrasonic survey protocol, public stakeholder notification filings specify a notice delivery radius of 1500 m.

information_points.title: Issues statutory public safety authorizations and excavation clearance certificates（MUNI）
information_points.content:
REG-MUNI-5S5：Under regulatory framework version Framework Version 2.0, the Continuous guided-wave screening protocol does not have municipal regulatory approval from the municipal pipeline safety oversight board.
REG-MUNI-LJM：Under regulatory framework version Framework Version 2.0, the Phased-array ultrasonic survey protocol has secured municipal regulatory approval from the municipal pipeline safety oversight board.
REG-MUNI-IM8：Under regulatory framework version Framework Version 3.0, the Phased-array ultrasonic survey protocol does not have municipal regulatory approval from the municipal pipeline safety oversight board.
REG-MUNI-OJQ：Under regulatory framework version Framework Version 2.0, the Pulsed eddy-current mapping protocol has obtained municipal regulatory approval following formal validation by the municipal pipeline safety oversight board.
